nodes.description: Public constant role identifier used to restrict lockTokens and exitTokens to managers.
Public constant token type identifier for MintableERC20Predicate.
Keccak256 of Transfer(address,address,uint256) used to validate exit log topic0.
Empty constructor for MintableERC20Predicate.
Initializes contract id and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE to _owner.
Locks ERC20 tokens by transferring amount from depositor to predicate, callable only by MANAGER_ROLE.
Validates burn log and transfers or mints tokens to withdrawer, callable only by MANAGER_ROLE.
Transaction sender used by only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier for access control.
External call via SafeERC20 that transfers tokens from depositor to this contract.
External call to mint additional tokens on root token when predicate balance is insufficient.
External call via SafeERC20 that transfers tokens from predicate to withdrawer.
Parameter of initialize; address receiving initial admin and manager roles.
Parameter of lockTokens; address whose tokens are transferred into predicate.
Parameter of lockTokens; address to receive tokens on child chain, only emitted in event.
Parameter of lockTokens; ERC20 token address being locked.
Parameter of lockTokens; ABI-encoded amount for deposit.
Unnamed address parameter of exitTokens; present in interface but unused.
Parameter of exitTokens; RLP-encoded burn log from child chain.
Local variable in lockTokens; decoded deposit amount.
Local variable in exitTokens; decoded RLP list of log fields.
Local variable in exitTokens; decoded RLP list of log topics.
Local variable in exitTokens; address decoded from log topic1.
Local variable in exitTokens; IMintableERC20 cast of rootToken.
Local variable in exitTokens; predicate balance of rootToken before transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked by only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier before executing lockTokens.
msg.sender is checked by only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier before executing exitTokens.
MANAGER_ROLE is required by only modifier in lockTokens.
MANAGER_ROLE is required by only modifier in exitTokens.
_owner parameter is used to set up initial roles in initialize.
initialize grants MANAGER_ROLE to _owner via _setupRole.
depositData is abi.decoded into amount local variable in lockTokens.
amount is passed as value argument to safeTransferFrom.
depositor is passed as from address to safeTransferFrom.
rootToken is the token target of safeTransferFrom.
lockTokens invokes safeTransferFrom external call.
log is converted to RLP item and then to logRLPList in exitTokens.
logRLPList[1] is converted to logTopicRLPList in exitTokens.
logTopicRLPList[1] is decoded into withdrawer address.
rootToken is cast to IMintableERC20 token in exitTokens.
token.balanceOf(address(this)) is assigned to tokenBalance.
logRLPList[2] is decoded into amount in exitTokens.
tokenBalance determines whether mint is needed and mint amount.
amount - tokenBalance is passed to token.mint.
token.mint is an external call to the root token contract.
withdrawer is passed as to address to safeTransfer.
amount is passed as value to safeTransfer.
rootToken is the token target of safeTransfer.
exitTokens conditionally calls token.mint when tokenBalance < amount.
exitTokens calls safeTransfer to send amount to withdrawer.
TRANSFER_EVENT_SIG is used in require to validate topic0 in exitTokens.
depositReceiver is used in LockedMintableERC20 event emitted by lockTokens.
Unnamed sender parameter exists in exitTokens interface but is unused.
exitTokens processes the log parameter for validation and decoding.
rootToken parameter is used in exitTokens for balance checks and transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner only used to initialize roles in initialize; merge into initialize function.
depositor is directly used as from address in safeTransferFrom unsafe operation.
depositReceiver is only used in event emission inside lockTokens.
rootToken in lockTokens is the token target of safeTransferFrom unsafe operation.
depositData is decoded only within lockTokens.
Unnamed sender parameter is part of exitTokens signature but unused; merge into exitTokens.
log is input processed by exitTokens for RLP decoding and validation.
amount in lockTokens is passed to safeTransferFrom unsafe operation.
logRLPList is an internal decoding result used within exitTokens.
logTopicRLPList is an internal decoding result used within exitTokens.
withdrawer is recipient address in safeTransfer unsafe operation.
token is used to invoke mint unsafe operation in exitTokens.
tokenBalance determines mint amount in mint unsafe operation.
